[package]
name = "tao"
version = "0.35.3"
description = "Cross-platform window manager library."
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy", "The winit contributors"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.74"
keywords = ["windowing"]
license = "Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tao"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/tao"
categories = ["gui"]
include = ["/README.md", "src/**/*.rs", "examples/**/*.rs", "LICENSE*"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["rwh_04", "rwh_05", "rwh_06", "serde", "x11", "dbus"]
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["i686-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "i686-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin"]

[features]
default = ["rwh_06", "x11", "dbus"]
serde = ["dep:serde", "dpi/serde"]
rwh_04 = ["dep:rwh_04"]
rwh_05 = ["dep:rwh_05"]
rwh_06 = ["dep:rwh_06"]
x11 = ["dep:gdkx11-sys", "dep:x11-dl"]
dbus = ["dep:dbus"]

[workspace]
members = ["tao-macros"]

[dependencies]
libc = "0.2"
log = "0.4"
once_cell = "1"
bitflags = "2"
crossbeam-channel = "0.5"
url = "2"
dpi = "0.1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
optional = true
features = ["serde_derive"]

[dependencies.rwh_04]
package = "raw-window-handle"
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.rwh_05]
package = "raw-window-handle"
version = "0.5"
features = ["std"]
optional = true

[dependencies.rwh_06]
package = "raw-window-handle"
version = "0.6"
features = ["std"]
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
image = "0.25"
env_logger = "0.11"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dev-dependencies]
softbuffer = "0.4"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies]
parking_lot = "0.12"
unicode-segmentation = "1.11"
windows-version = "0.1"
windows-core = "0.61"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.61"
features = ["Win32_Devices_HumanInterfaceDevice", "Win32_Foundation", "Win32_Globalization", "Win32_Graphics_Dwm", "Win32_Graphics_Gdi", "Win32_System_Com", "Win32_System_Com_StructuredStorage", "Win32_System_DataExchange", "Win32_System_Diagnostics_Debug", "Win32_System_LibraryLoader", "Win32_System_Memory", "Win32_System_Ole", "Win32_System_Registry", "Win32_System_SystemServices", "Win32_System_Threading", "Win32_System_WindowsProgramming", "Win32_System_SystemInformation", "Win32_UI_Accessibility", "Win32_UI_Controls", "Win32_UI_HiDpi", "Win32_UI_Input_Ime", "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse", "Win32_UI_Input_Pointer", "Win32_UI_Input_Touch", "Win32_UI_Shell", "Win32_UI_TextServices", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
jni = "0.21"
ndk = "0.9"
ndk-sys = "0.6"
percent-encoding = "2.3"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies.tao-macros]
version = "0.1.0"
path = "./tao-macros"

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"ios\", target_os = \"macos\"))".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6"
block2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
core-foundation = "0.10"
core-graphics = "0.25"
dispatch2 = "0.3"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSArray", "NSAttributedString", "NSAutoreleasePool", "NSDate", "NSDictionary", "NSEnumerator", "NSGeometry", "NSObjCRuntime", "NSRange", "NSString", "NSThread", "NSURL"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "objc2-core-foundation", "NSApplication", "NSButton", "NSColor", "NSControl", "NSEvent", "NSGraphics", "NSImage", "NSOpenGLView", "NSPasteboard", "NSResponder", "NSRunningApplication", "NSScreen", "NSView", "NSWindow", "NSUserActivity"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"ios\")".dependencies.objc2-ui-kit]
version = "0.3"
features = ["UIResponder", "UIScene", "UISceneOptions", "UIOpenURLContext"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"ios\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["NSProcessInfo"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies]
gtk = "0.18"
gdkwayland-sys = "0.18.0"
parking_lot = "0.12"
dlopen2 = "0.8.0"

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.gdkx11-sys]
version = "0.18"
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.x11-dl]
version = "2.21"
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.dbus]
version = "0.9"
optional = true

[package]
name = "tao-macros"
description = "Proc macros for tao"
version = "0.1.3"
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
rust-version = "1.74"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "../README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tao"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/tao-macros"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[features]
default = []

[dependencies]
proc-macro2 = "1"
quote = "1"

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2"
features = ["full"]
